QF.id: SIA Case Studies on SAS Standards_52

question.text: In an affordable-housing engagement, the SIA assesses improved water and sanitation facilities. The BEST means of verification includes:

answer.text: Physical inspection / visits of repaired houses and toilets, review of project documents, beneficiary interviews, and KPI measurement for improved water and sanitation facilities

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook supports physical visits and inspection of repaired houses and toilets, review of project documents, beneficiary interviews, and KPI-based measurement of improved water and sanitation facilities as the means of verification. The Trap: Handover photos alone, family messages and news articles are single-source or irrelevant evidence. Note: Disclose the mix of inspection, documentation review and beneficiary interviews used to evidence the water and sanitation outcomes.
